rows.parent_standard_state: pure liquid WO3 at 1 bar and 1923 K
rows.source_citation: Wood & Wade (2013), Contributions to Mineralogy and Petrology 166, 911–921, doi:10.1007/s00410-013-0896-z
rows.source_locator: pp. 916–917, exchange reaction (9), fit, and Fig. 4 contours for Diopside–Anorthite–Forsterite at 1,650 °C.
limitations: contour-read (provisional): gamma endpoints are inferred from Fig. 4 contour labels, not a tabulated interval.
The source reports a fit standard error corresponding to a factor of about 1.5–1.6, not a gamma interval; the full contour range is retained as the band.

The WO3 treatment assumes W⁶⁺ dominance, supported above about ΔIW −3.5 by Wade, Wood & Norris (2013), The oxidation state of tungsten in silicate melt at high pressures and temperatures, Chemical Geology 335, 189–193, doi:10.1016/j.chemgeo.2012.10.011; lower-fO₂ use requires W speciation. The activity paper reports no aggregate oxygen-fugacity window.
